title: Attack Prompt Generation for Red Teaming and Defending Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating adversarial attack prompts using a semi-automatic red teaming framework to induce harmful or racist material, and evaluating the harmfulness of the target model's responses using a judge LLM on a scale of 0 to 10.

Using a semi-automatic red teaming framework (combining manual examples and in-context learning) to generate attack prompts related to religion, and scoring the harmfulness of the model's outputs with an evaluation LLM.
Testing the language model's safety against automatically generated adversarial prompts targeting political topics, with the harmfulness of the resulting outputs evaluated by a judge model.
